name: number-pop-in
description: A transitions.dev-inspired digit pop-in with blur, lift, and staggered value reveal

vars.description: The number itself. Every character becomes its own span, so the stagger still lands character by character.
Small suffix printed after the number. Pass an empty string to drop it.
Scales the offset the timeline drives, so the characters cover a shorter or longer run in the same time.
Number colour: ink for light frames, paper for dark ones, accent rides --brand.
